errors.register_without_ca_failed: ❌ register-certificate-without-ca failed — is the certificate PEM valid?
errors.register_ca_sni_failed: ❌ register-ca-certificate (SNI_ONLY) failed — is the CA PEM valid?

status.cert_registered_header: 🪪 Certificate registered in the destination Region (no new cert minted)
status.cert_id_derived_note: (This id is derived from the certificate, so it matches the id the certificate has in the lobby Region.)
status.same_cert_recognized: ✅ The same certificate is now recognized in the destination Region.
status.next_get_endpoint: Next: get that Region's iot:Data-ATS endpoint and reconnect the SAME certificate to it (the 'move' subcommand).
status.ca_trusted_note: Every device certificate this CA signed is now trusted in this Region,
status.ca_sni_validated_note: validated by the SNI hostname the device presents. No per-cert registration needed.
status.reconnecting_move: 🔌 Reconnecting '{}' with the SAME certificate to the destination endpoint {} ...
status.move_complete: 🎉 Move complete — the same certificate is now connected to the destination Region.
status.move_complete_note: No new certificate was minted; only the endpoint changed.

cli.description: Multi-Account Registration (MAR): register an existing certificate in a destination Region and reconnect the same certificate to that Region's endpoint.

register_without_ca.help: Register an existing device certificate in the destination Region (no CA).
register_without_ca.certificate_pem: Path to the device certificate PEM.
register_without_ca.policy_name: Device policy to create/attach in the destination.
register_without_ca.policy_document: Policy JSON to create (if --policy-name is new).
register_without_ca.thing_name: Optional thing to create + attach in the destination.

register_ca_sni.help: Register a CA in SNI_ONLY (multi-account) mode in the destination Region.
register_ca_sni.ca_certificate: Path to the CA certificate PEM.

endpoint.region: Region to describe the data endpoint for.

move.help: Reconnect the same certificate to the destination endpoint.
move.thing_name: Device/thing name (used as the MQTT client id).
move.cert: Path to the SAME device certificate PEM.
move.key: Path to the SAME device private key.

operations.attach_device_policy_to_moved_certificat: Attach device policy to moved certificate
